verdict.rationale: Firebase offers Gemini in Firebase's natural-language chat interface for product Q&A/code generation/troubleshooting, plus an official MCP server enabling AI agents to manage Firebase resources via natural-language-driven tool calls (verified hands-on handshake). However, these are auxiliary AI assistants layered on top of the console/CLI rather than the product itself being natively operable end-to-end via NL commands for all core operations (Firestore queries, security rules, deployments still require code/CLI). missing for 10: evidence of comprehensive NL control over all core Firebase operations (not just chat Q&A and MCP-mediated agent actions), independent hands-on validation of Gemini in Firebase's command execution accuracy, and confirmation MCP server covers full CRUD/deploy surface rather than a subset of features.
